# adlc_backup_gpo_export (Data Source)

Exports a live GPO as a native GPMC backup using `Backup-GPO`, regardless of whether the GPO was created manually, with `adlc_json_gpo`, or with `adlc_backup_gpo`. Returns every backup file as base64, including binary policy files. The provider creates a temporary backup on the remote host and removes it after reading the files; it does not write files on the machine running Terraform.

Persist `files` with `local_sensitive_file` from the `hashicorp/local` provider using `content_base64`. The resulting `<path>/<name>/{backup_id}/...` folder can be used by `adlc_backup_gpo` with `path` pointing at its parent and `backup_name` set to `name`. Materialize the files in a separate export apply before configuring the import resource, which reads its local backup folder during planning.

Every read creates a new snapshot with a new `backup_id` and backup timestamps, even if the policy settings have not changed. Uses `gpo_powershell_path` (default `powershell.exe`) and requires the `GroupPolicy` module. Backup contents are stored in Terraform state; keep that state secure. This data source does not manage GPO links or create an automatic cross-domain migration table.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "adlc_backup_gpo_export" "defender" {
  name = "DoD Microsoft Defender Antivirus STIG Computer v2r4"
}

resource "local_sensitive_file" "defender_backup" {
  for_each = nonsensitive(toset(keys(data.adlc_backup_gpo_export.defender.files)))

  filename       = "${path.module}/backup_gpo/${data.adlc_backup_gpo_export.defender.name}/${each.key}"
  content_base64 = data.adlc_backup_gpo_export.defender.files[each.key]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name of the live GPO to export.

### Read-Only

- `backup_id` (String) GUID of this backup snapshot. A new snapshot is created on every read.
- `files` (Map of String, Sensitive) Map of forward-slash-separated relative backup file paths to base64-encoded file contents. Snapshot files include the `{backup_id}` directory; root catalog files such as `manifest.xml` keep their root-relative paths. Sensitive because a GPO backup can contain credentials or other secrets.
- `id` (String) The source GPO's GUID, not the backup snapshot GUID.
